purpose: Public monorepo for the TaxKit tax engine, calculators, HTTP API, TypeScript SDK, and documentation runtime.
identitySource: git rev-parse HEAD, git status --short --branch, and the content-addressed candidate manifest

representativeJobs.acceptedOutcome: Schema-backed calculator operations return rule-owned results for canonical fixtures.
The dist-only tarball installs and supported public entrypoints import without workspace source.
Local health, metadata, calculation, schema-error, and OpenAPI responses match owning Schemas.
Validated content renders and the browser harness observes navigation, server functions, recoverable errors, and clean console behavior.
The local report-only release-readiness graph completes nine checks with bounded evidence and no external mutation.

boundaryFacts: Package, API, SDK, app, and public documentation behavior remains owned by code, Schemas, manifests, exports, and direct READMEs.
The local release-readiness graph grants no versioning, Git, registry, release, deployment, provider, public-site, or recovery authority.
The existing Quality workflow invokes bun run release:check -- --ci; that graph begins with root verification and remains the sole hosted CI route.
Exactly four operational runbooks and docs/operations/authority-model.md remain the repeatable operation and authority owners.
Repository-local skills and validators must work from a clean clone without reading a user home or global skill installation.
exclusions: Dependency, build, cache, generated route, temporary, binary, and vendored trees are excluded from readable corpus accounting.
Website design, public MDX copy, navigation, package/API/SDK/runtime behavior, provider access, and external mutation are outside this migration.
HGI-203 through HGI-206 evidence is preserved and not rewritten.
nonClaims: Repository-local validation does not establish hosted CI success.
Local Git commits do not establish push, remote branch, tag, or release state.
No registry publication, package versioning, external consumer behavior, provider state, deployment, production behavior, or public-site availability is established.
A target-specific harness epoch does not establish general causal effectiveness for other workers, repositories, or future skill states.
